messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands in profile, then turns toward the camera and performs a short dance, raising his arms and bending his knees before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"A static, medium-wide shot at eye level keeps the man centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white long-sleeved shirt under a dark vest, red trousers, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair with a faded side and a slightly longer top.","identity":"A young man with a slim build and short dark hair, shown in profile and then facing the camera.","scene":"A wet, reflective plaza in front of a large glass building with glowing green circular lights and pink neon accents, with city buildings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a daytime fairground with a carousel and striped kiosk to a wet reflective plaza in front of a glass building with green circular neon lights and pink accents, matching the reference. The man's dance action, clothing, and static centered framing were largely preserved, and his lighting now reflects the cooler neon environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the amusement-park scene with the reference futuristic plaza environment while preserving the man's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, and adapt his lighting to the new scene.
uncertain: Whether the man's facial expression was fully preserved due to the low-resolution frames.
unexpected_changes: The man's cap visible in the source is absent in the output, leaving only short dark hair.
